interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular clearing of leaves and debris to maintain a safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion
interventions.description: Constructing a sidewalk on the right side to provide a complete pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security at night.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly trim trees and bushes to ensure the full width of the sidewalk remains clear and accessible.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair cracks in the existing sidewalk and consider widening it to meet modern accessibility standards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve driver awareness of pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Paving
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk material and level continue across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: If this street experiences high speeds, curb extensions at nearby intersections could shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the width of the sidewalk to at least 5-6 feet to improve accessibility and comfort.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Leveling
interventions.description: Repair or grind down uneven concrete joints to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface for all users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically regulate vehicle speeds to a safe residential level.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Install a sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians on both sides.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Root Management
interventions.description: Repair the damaged sidewalk sections using root-friendly methods or flexible paving materials to eliminate trip hazards while preserving mature trees.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near any potential crossing points to ensure pedestrians are visible to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Installation of pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Furniture or Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street furniture or planters where space allows to create a psychological and physical buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Collection Zones
interventions.description: Establish designated areas for waste bins that do not encroach on the clear walking width of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface or patch the cracked sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible path.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Vegetation Pruning
interventions.description: Prune the overhanging tree branches to ensure a minimum vertical clearance of 80 inches (approx. 2 meters) for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Walkway Widening
interventions.description: If this is a public thoroughfare, widen the paved surface to at least 5 feet to meet standard accessibility guidelines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe walking path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Smooth crossing surfaces
interventions.description: Ensure that any designated crossing areas have smooth, level surfaces to accommodate all users.
